spec.query:
import "array"
latest = from(bucket: "senior_project")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "object_detection" and r._field == "sensor_value" and r.device == "WISE-4012")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: if uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r._time) <= uint(v: 15s) then 1 else 0}))
fallback = array.from(rows: [{_time: time(v: 0), _value: 0}])
union(tables: [fallback, latest]) |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> last()

from(bucket: "senior_project") |> range(start: -30d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "object_detection_event" and r._field == "object_count" and r.sensor == "EZ-18M" and r.channel == "DI1") |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000.0}))

from(bucket: "senior_project") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "object_detection" and r._field == "sensor_value" and r.sensor == "PZ-G41N" and r.channel == "DI0") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "_field", value: "PZ-G41N (DI0)")

from(bucket: "senior_project") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "object_detection" and r._field == "sensor_value" and r.sensor == "EZ-18M" and r.channel == "DI1") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> set(key: "_field", value: "EZ-18M (DI1)")

from(bucket: "senior_project")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "object_detection_event" and r._field == "object_count" and r.sensor == "PZ-G41N" and r.channel == "DI0")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))

from(bucket: "senior_project") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "object_detection_event" and r._field == "object_count") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "sensor", "channel"]) |> rename(columns: {_time: "Timestamp", _value: "Object Count", sensor: "Sensor", channel: "Channel"}) |> sort(columns: ["Timestamp"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 50)

from(bucket: "senior_project") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "object_detection_event" and r._field == "object_count" and r.sensor == "EZ-18M" and r.channel == "DI1") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: count, createEmpty: false) |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))

from(bucket: "senior_project") |> range(start: -30d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "object_detection" and r._field == "sensor_value" and r.device == "WISE-4012") |> group() |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: uint(v: r._time)) / 1000000.0}))

spec.title: MiR Fleet - Live Map (2 robots)
spec.description: MiR_S1299 (green) and MiR_S1300 (blue), read-only live positions polled independently every second. S1300 uses approximate translation between two copies of the room map; verify on site.
